verdict.rationale: Anytype documents linking between objects as the basis of a connected knowledge base, says you can trace how ideas relate and see what is connected to a project, and offers a live Graph of connections. The evidence never mentions [[wiki-style]] link syntax, a backlinks panel showing links in context, or unlinked-mention detection, so only the core idea of linked notes is supported. Missing for 10: documented [[ ]] link syntax, an explicit backlinks view with surrounding context, unlinked mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
